title: Finland – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – Technical Consultancy Services Related to Rolling Stock
description: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE OF THE PROCUREMENT RailStock Finland Oy (hereinafter “Railstock”) is launching a tendering procedure for technical consultancy services related to the rolling stock it manages. The purpose of this procurement is to establish a framework for obtaining high‑quality, independent technical consultancy services that support Railstock in the management, development and procurement of rolling stock used in publicly funded passenger rail services in Finland. SCOPE OF THE PROCUREMENT The subject matter of the procurement is a comprehensive package of technical expert and consultancy services related to rolling stock, supporting the rolling stock owner in, inter alia, technical assessments, procurement preparation, lifecycle management, planning of maintenance and heavy overhauls, safety and approval matters, as well as other expert tasks connected with the ownership and development of rolling stock. Railstock has divided the procurement into the following lots: 1. Owner’s Engineer Support 2. Procurement Support (Rolling Stock) 3. Lifecycle, LCC & Fleet Strategy 4. Safety, Regulation & ECM Certification 5. Testing, Acceptance, Audits & QA 6. Maintenance, Overhaul & Modification Procurement 7. ESG Reporting 8. IT Systems, Network Architecture & Cybersecurity 9. Technical Design (Engineering & Modifications) 10. ETCS Retrofit & Upgrade Procurement Support 11. Rolling Stock Documentation Management & DMS Support The lots and the services to be procured under each lot are described in more detail in the invitation to tender and its annexes, which also set out Railstock’s requirements concerning the suitability of tenderers and the minimum requirements applicable to the services. PROCUREMENT DOCUMENTS The procurement documents consist of the following documents: - This contract notice - Annex 1: Draft Agreement - Annex 1.1: Data Protection, Information Security and Confidentiality Annex - Annex 1.2: Sanctions undertakings - Annex 2.1: Service description, Lot 1 - Annex 2.2: Service description, Lot 2 - Annex 2.3: Service description, Lot 3 - Annex 2.4: Service description, Lot 4 - Annex 2.5: Service description, Lot 5 - Annex 2.6: Service description, Lot 6 - Annex 2.7: Service description, Lot 7 - Annex 2.8: Service description, Lot 8 - Annex 2.9: Service description, Lot 9 - Annex 2.10: Service description, Lot 10 - Annex 2.11: Service description, Lot 11 - Annex 3.1: Tender Form, Lot 1 - Annex 3.2: Tender Form, Lot 2 - Annex 3.3: Tender Form, Lot 3 - Annex 3.4: Tender Form, Lot 4 - Annex 3.5: Tender Form, Lot 5 - Annex 3.6: Tender Form, Lot 6 - Annex 3.7: Tender Form, Lot 7 - Annex 3.8: Tender Form, Lot 8 - Annex 3.9: Tender Form, Lot 9 - Annex 3.10: Tender Form, Lot 10 - Annex 3.11: Tender Form, Lot 11

title: Pelkosenniemen kunnan tilintarkastuspalvelut 2027-2030 + optio 2031-2032
description: Pelkosenniemen kunnan tilintarkastuspalvelut 2027-2030 + optio 2031-2032 Pelkosenniemen kunta pyytää tarjousta kuntalain (410/2015) mukaisista tilintarkastuspalveluista. Pelkosenniemen kunta on runsaan 900 asukkaan kunta Itä-Lapissa. Kunnan tilinpäätöksen toimintakate vuonna 2025 oli 4,4 miljoonaa euroa. Pelkosenniemen kunta on ulkoistanut kirjanpito- ja palkanlaskentapalvelunsa Monetra Oulu Oy:lle. Hankinnan kohteena on kunnan hallinnon ja talouden tarkastus sekä muut lakisääteiset tilintarkastustehtävät, mukaan lukien kunnan tytäryhteisöjen tilintarkastus. Varsinainen sopimuskausi koskee tilikausien 2027-2030 tilintarkastusta. Hankintayksiköllä on oikeus ottaa käyttöön yksi (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokausi, joka koskee tilikausien 2031-2032 tilintarkastusta. Palveluun tulee sisältyä vähintään: - kuntalain mukainen hallinnon ja talouden tarkastus; - tilinpäätöksen tarkastus; - tilintarkastuskertomuksen laatiminen; - tarkastuslautakunnan avustaminen sen tarvitsemassa laajuudessa; - osallistuminen tarvittaessa tarkastuslautakunnan kokouksiin; - tarkastushavaintojen raportointi; - muut lakisääteiset tilintarkastustehtävät. Tarkastuksen arvioitu kokonaislaajuus on noin 8 tarkastuspäivää vuodessa. Hankintayksikön arvio sisältää kunnan sekä sen tytäryhteisöjen tilintarkastuksen. Arvio ei sido hankintayksikköä. Tarjoajan tulee laskea tarjoushinta koko vuoden tarkastuksesta omaan arvioonsa perustuen, sisältäen kunnan ja tytäryhtiöiden tarkastuksen. Tilintarkastuspalvelut tarvittavine kokouksineen on mahdollista suorittaa etäyhteyksin. Tarkastuslautakunta pitää 4–6 kokousta vuodessa. Dale Bish: uwo8@cdc.gov; 404.498.1312 Henrietta Fumbah: ehu0@cdc.gov, 770.488.8239 (2) Set-asides. Small business set-asides are applicable by domain. Domain 1: 25% Small Business Set-Aside (Partial Small Business Set-Aside) Domain 2: 25% Small Business Set-Aside Aside (Partial Small Business Set-Aside) Domain 3: 25% Small Business Set-Aside Aside (Partial Small Business Set-Aside) Domain 4: 25% Small Business Set-Aside Aside (Partial Small Business Set-Aside) Domain 5: 100% Small Business Set-Aside (Total Small Business Set-Aside) (3) Codes for services or supplies. The following NAICS codes and size standards are anticipated: NAICS 541690 Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services ($19M) NAICS 541715 Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) (1,000 Employees) NAICS 611430 Professional and Management Development Training ($15M) (4) Description. (i) The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Center for Emerging and Zoonotic Infectious Diseases (NCEZID), Division of Healthcare Quality Promotion (DHQP), announces its intent to compete a new Indefinite-Delivery/Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract vehicle titled �Safety, Prevention, Epidemiology, and Education Development for Health Care and Antimicrobial Resistance (SPEED).� SPEED will provide CDC with an "as needed" mechanism to obtain healthcare epidemiology, health behavior, and healthcare-associated infection research support across five functional domains: (1) Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services; (2) Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services; (3) Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services; (4) Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services; and (5) Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination, and Testing Services. The anticipated ordering period (period of performance) for the SPEED IDIQ is a 60-month period beginning on March 30, 2027 and ending March 29, 2032. Offerors may submit proposals to one or more domains and will be evaluated on technical approach including existing infrastructure and capacity, staffing approach, management approach, similar experience, price, and past performance. To ensure continuity of critical healthcare epidemiology and infection prevention research support with no lapse in service, DHQP extended the current Safe Healthcare, Epidemiology, Prevention Research Development (SHEPheRD) Program contracts through March 29, 2027, the day immediately preceding the SPEED anticipated effective start date. This extension allows CDC to maintain uninterrupted access to essential scientific, technical, and programmatic support while the SPEED solicitation, evaluation, and award process is completed. DHQP intends for SPEED to fully replace SHEPheRD upon award. CDC will provide further information regarding the solicitation timeline, evaluation criteria, and instructions for interested offerors in forthcoming notices. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor SAM.gov for the official solicitation and any applicable updates. SPEED shall consist of 5 Domains briefly described as follows: Domain 1: Domestic Antimicrobial Resistance, Infection Prevention and Control, and Adverse Events Services. The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that support the design, execution, and assessment of healthcare and community epidemiology research initiatives addressing antimicrobial resistance (AR), infection prevention and control (IPC), and adverse events domestically within U.S. healthcare settings and communities. These implementation services include developing and implementing study protocols, conducting clinical and epidemiologic investigations, evaluating outcomes, and translating research findings into scalable, evidence-based public health interventions. Domain 2: Healthcare Information Technology and Data Solutions Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for the development and deployment of digital health systems, advanced analytics, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and machine learning-driven tools, and mathematical modeling to strengthen surveillance, automate data processing, improve data quality, and enhance decision-making across health programs. This includes the ability of Offerors to develop, implement, or maintain healthcare or ancillary medical (e.g., laboratory, pharmacy, etc.) surveillance systems, deploy natural language processing applications and other artificial intelligence tools, conduct human factors engineering, and apply mathematical modeling to optimize system usability, workflow efficiency, and data interpretation Domain 3: Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Infection Prevention and Control Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services for development and implementation of research projects and protocols focused on antimicrobial stewardship, antimicrobial resistance detection and control, global health coordination, surveillance, and prevention of healthcare-associated infections in global healthcare settings. These tasks include, but are not limited to, conducting program evaluations, clinical investigations, cost effectiveness and disease modeling analyses, and translating findings into scalable and sustainable public health interventions with a particular focus on low- and middle-income countries. Domain 4: Emergency Preparedness, Response Services, and Healthcare System Resilience Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services to rapidly respond to healthcare quality and safety threats. Services that may be conducted under this domain include supporting CDC's ability to respond effectively and rapidly to outbreaks, emergencies, and public health threats during times of healthcare facility or health system stress or strain. Domain 5: Workforce Training, Message Development, Dissemination and Testing Services The purpose of this domain is to obtain services that strengthen the capacity, knowledge, and preparedness of healthcare workers, public health personnel (including CDC staff), and the general public to prevent infections and reduce the spread of antimicrobial resistance and other infectious disease threats. title: OSTWIND Market Development 2027–2029
description:
Current Situation

OSTWIND and the participating cantons aim to shift commuter traffic toward public transportation and other sustainable modes of transportation. During the current contract period, data-driven potential analyses, business development activities, corporate mobility concepts, licensing agreements, and operational processes were established. Ongoing corporate projects will continue beyond the end of the current contract.


The contractor must therefore fulfill two tasks simultaneously: attract new companies or clusters of companies with high potential for shifting to public transit, and ensure the continuity of existing projects. The contract is structured as a comprehensive service, ranging from market prioritization and negotiations to stable implementation, ongoing support and further development, as well as an orderly handover.


Crucial is the contractor’s ability to design effective processes, coordinate them with OSTWIND and the contracting cantons, put them into operation, monitor them, and further develop them. Proprietary solutions that serve to fulfill the objectives of this contract may be offered separately to corporate clients, provided that the client’s own or other suitable implementation methods are supported to an equivalent degree and that economic interests and dependencies are disclosed transparently.


Project Objectives

The project aims to use data to identify suitable companies and locations with significant relocation potential, approach them, and persuade them to adopt corporate mobility concepts. In collaboration with the companies (clients), OSTWIND, the contracting cantons, and other partners, economically and operationally viable solutions are to be developed and brought to the decision-making stage.


The agreed-upon mobility concepts are to be translated into functional and manageable operational processes, supported throughout the contract period, and further developed based on usage and impact. At the same time, existing company projects must continue without interruption, and the necessary conditions for a future handover and sustainable continued operation must be established. Annual targets (e.g., acquisition of [number] companies with [number] employees, etc.) will be agreed upon with the contractor.


General Terms and Conditions

OSTWIND is awarding a contract for the term from January 1, 2027, to December 31, 2029. There are two options to extend the contract by one year each (maximum contract term: 5 years). OSTWIND has sole discretion to decide whether to exercise the extension options. The decision to extend the mandate is made separately for each option year. Exercising the first extension option does not confer any entitlement to a further one-year extension.


The contractor bears overall responsibility for the methodological, organizational, and procedural integration of the defined work packages. The scope covers the OSTWIND fare network area and the cantons participating in the program: AI, AR, GL, SG, SH, TG, SZ (March only). The focus is on employers, business locations, and clusters with significant potential for sustainable workplace mobility and a substantial connection to public transportation. Municipalities, cantons, transportation companies, and complementary mobility providers will be involved as needed.


The targeted performance objectives are set forth in the tender documents and the associated appendices. The quantities specified serve as planning guidelines and do not constitute a purchase guarantee, unless expressly stated otherwise.


Components of the Request for Proposals

The Terms of Reference, together with the following appendices, form the binding basis for the procurement process:


Appendix 1: Requirements Catalog

Appendix 2: Case Study

Appendix 3: References and Key Personnel

Appendix 4: Price Sheet

Appendix 5: Declaration Sheet

Appendix 6: Evaluation Grid


In the event of discrepancies in the level of detail between the Terms of Reference and an appendix, the specific provisions of the relevant appendix shall apply to the respective subject matter.

description: Genom sitt regleringsbrev har Socialstyrelsen i uppdrag att representera Sverige i den EU-gemensamma styrgruppen för samordnade upphandlingar inom ramen för Joint Procurement Agreement (JPA). Uppdraget omfattar avrop som är kopplade till myndighetens ansvar för att säkerställa försörjningen av läkemedel och övriga sjukvårdsprodukter inför en höjd beredskap samt för att upprätthålla den katastrofmedicinska beredskapen. Därutöver inkluderar uppdraget inköp av läkemedel genom den så kallade frivilliga solidaritetsmekanisen (VSM) i EU i situationer där ordinarie försörjningskanaler inte kan tillgodose den nationella behov. Enheten för Försörjningsberedskap på Socialstyrelsen utvecklar hälso- och sjukvårdens, och omsorgens försörjningsberedskap på strategisk nivå, men också den operativa delen av försörjningsberedskapen, exempelvis genom att bygga upp och förvalta beredskapslager. Utöver detta planerar enheten hur materiel, utrustning och läkemedel ska kunna levereras vid behov – både inom Sverige och internationellt. För att kunna uppfylla dessa uppdrag avser myndigheten att upphandla ett distributionsavtal med en viss lagerhållning. Om ett inköp via olika EU-mekanismer skulle initieras av myndigheten ska leverantören vara redo att ta emot leveransen, lagerhålla och distribuera till de kunder (till exempel regioner eller apotek) som myndigheten anger. Lagringstid och distributionsperiod kan variera beroende av sammanhanget.

title: Germany – Road construction works – Grundhafter Ausbau der Wallrothstraße mit statischen Hangsicherungen sowie Neubau eines gemeinsamen Geh-/Radweges in 99734 Nordhausen; 2. Bauabschnitt
description: Die Stadt Nordhausen baut die Wallrothstraße grundhaft aus. Die Maßnahme wird in mehreren Bauabschnitten durchgeführt. Im 1. Bauabschnitt (Station 0-085 bis 0+340) ist der Ausbau einschließlich eines neuen Regenwasserkanals bereits erfolgt. Mit diesem Verfahren werden die Bauleistungen für den 2. Bauabschnitt von Bau-km 0+340 bis Bau-km 0+508 ausgeschrieben (in dieser Bekanntgabe unter Punkt 5 als LOT-0001 geführt). Die Straße verläuft in diesem Abschnitt in ausgeprägter Hanglage. Die talseitige Böschung ist nicht standsicher; die Standsicherheit wird über drei Ingenieurbauwerke hergestellt, die den Schwerpunkt der Maßnahme bilden: - eine überschnittene Bohrpfahlwand von Station 0+400 bis 0+508, Länge rd. 108 m, abgewickelte Wandfläche rd. 1.350 m², Großbohrpfähle nach DIN EN 1536 mit D = 88 cm, rückverankert mit 29 Mikropfählen nach DIN EN 14199; darauf Kopfbalken und Kappe aus Stahlbeton, - eine Winkelstützwand aus Stahlbetonfertigteilen von Station 0+420 bis 0+508, Länge rd. 90 m, - eine Böschungsstabilisierung in bewehrter Erde mit Geogittern von Station 0+340 bis 0+400. Hinzu kommen der grundhafte Straßenausbau einschließlich Oberflächenentwässerung, ein gemeinsamer Geh- und Radweg, der abschnittsweise über die Kappe der Bohrpfahlwand geführt wird, eine Querungshilfe mit Bodenindikatoren, die Straßenbeleuchtung sowie die Anpassung des bergseitigen Waldweges. Besondere Randbedingungen der Ausführung: - Der Baubereich steht unter Kampfmittelverdacht; vor den Erd- und Bohrarbeiten ist eine Sondierung erforderlich. - Unter der Bestandsfahrbahn befindet sich eine mit polyzyklischen aromatischen Kohlenwasserstoffen belastete Packlage. Für deren Ausbau gelten der Leitfaden C 316 und die TRGS 551. - Im Baufeld verläuft eine in Betrieb befindliche Mittelspannungstrasse des örtlichen Netzbetreibers, die während der Bauzeit zu sichern ist. - Die Baumfäll- und Rodungsarbeiten unterliegen der Bindung nach § 39 Abs. 5 BNatSchG und sind nur außerhalb der Zeit vom 1. März bis 30. September zulässig. - Die Arbeitsebene für die Bohrpfahlarbeiten ist die vorhandene Fahrbahn mit einer befestigten Breite von rd. 5,65 m. Die Baumaßnahme wird in drei zeitlich getrennten Ausführungsabschnitten ausgeführt: - Abschnitt 1: Baumfäll- und Gehölzarbeiten, 18.01.2027 bis 28.02.2027. - Abschnitt 2.1: Hauptbaumaßnahme, 03/2027 bis 12/2027. - Abschnitt 2.2: Fertigstellung der Hauptbaumaßnahme, 04/2028 bis 06/2028. Zwischen Abschnitt 1 und Abschnitt 2.1 ruhen die Arbeiten. Zwischen Abschnitt 2.1 und Abschnitt 2.2 liegt die Winterunterbrechung ab dem 18.12.2027. Eine Unterteilung der hier ausgeschriebenen Leistung in weitere Lose ist nicht vorgesehen.
